params.name: shoulder

params.name: play

params.name: mortice_w

params.name: mortice_h

params.name: cheek_past

params.name: knot_up

params.name: hitch_w

params.name: pins
params.comment: pins across, the hitch's and the tuning's

params.name: tune_extra

params.name: facet

params.name: g_A
params.comment: read only: the outer outline's half-width

params.name: g_band
params.comment: read only: the band over the arch, wall to wall

params.name: g_Hs
params.comment: read only: the outer outline's straight sides

params.name: g_rc
params.comment: read only: its bottom corners' radius

params.name: g_cx
params.comment: read only: the corners' centres, either side

params.name: g_Rb
params.comment: read only: the bump's radius, tangent to both corners

params.name: o_r
params.comment: read only: the outer face's ends' radius

params.name: h_ri
params.comment: read only: the hole face's arch
